email_subject: Application for Intern UI Designer – Baver Ok
email_body:
Dear Qllix HR Team,

I am writing to apply for the Intern UI Designer position. With a background in web design and front-end development, I am eager to bring my skills to your design team and grow as a UI/UX professional.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, focusing on responsive design and user-friendly layouts. I have also designed and built mirook.com, a multi-page site where I implemented structured data and technical SEO, demonstrating my attention to detail and ability to create functional, accessible interfaces.

My experience with front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) gives me a solid understanding of how designs translate into code, which helps me collaborate effectively with developers. I am passionate about UI/UX and eager to learn from your senior designers, contribute to design systems, and create wireframes and prototypes.

I have attached my resume and portfolio for your review. I am available for an interview at your convenience and can start immediately.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Qllix HR Team,

I am excited to apply for the Intern UI Designer position at Qllix. As a junior professional with hands-on experience in web design and front-end development, I am eager to contribute to your design team and develop my skills in UI/UX.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I build and maintain client websites using WordPress, Elementor, and the Astra theme. This involves creating responsive layouts, ensuring mobile-first design, and collaborating with content and marketing teams to deliver user-friendly pages. My technical background includes front-end development at ViviDoctor, where I worked with AngularJS and JavaScript to optimize a healthcare web application, giving me a strong understanding of how design and code interact.

I have also designed and built mirook.com, a multi-page WordPress site for a Belgian youth chess champion. From structuring the site to implementing JSON-LD schema and ensuring fast, accessible design, I have applied principles of user-centered design and attention to detail. This project demonstrates my ability to create wireframes, mockups, and prototypes, as well as my commitment to iterative improvement based on feedback.

I am passionate about UI/UX and eager to learn from experienced designers. I am comfortable collaborating with developers and product teams, and I am proactive in seeking feedback to refine my work. My portfolio includes academic and personal projects that showcase my design thinking and technical skills.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and am available for on-site work. I am enthusiastic about the opportunity to contribute to Qllix's projects and grow as a designer.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can add value to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
